# Lightverse - Web3 Reputation Platform

> Where Light Becomes Reality

## About

Lightverse is a 3D cosmic universe platform where users earn Light—a reputation currency—through genuine contribution. Light cannot be bought, only earned, creating a meritocratic Web3 identity system.

## Key Concepts

### Light
- Reputation currency that can't be purchased
- Earned through contribution, knowledge sharing, and building
- Follows users across all communities in the verse
- Unlocks new galaxies and opportunities

### Galaxies
- **Lumina Archives**: Cosmic library where learning earns Light
- **Identity Nebula**: User reputation and Light Signature
- More galaxies emerge as the universe grows

### Features
- 3D navigable universe
- Portable Web3 reputation
- Achievement system with permanent badges
- Decentralized identity (wallet-based)
- Gas-free Light earning

## Use Cases

- Building portable Web3 reputation
- Earning recognition for community contributions
- Learning Web3 concepts while earning Light
- Exploring gamified educational content
- Establishing verifiable digital identity

## Technology

- React + Three.js (3D universe)
- Laravel backend
- Blockchain integration (Web3)
- Inertia.js (SPA architecture)
